description: This Java class 'YearStatistics' is part of a book management application. It provides statistics related to books read in the current year, including finding least and most liked books and calculating the average rating. It extends the 'Statistics' class and interacts with 'Book' objects and a 'PredefinedShelfService'.

classes.name: YearStatistics
classes.description: Provides statistics for books read in the current year within the book tracking application.

methods.name: YearStatistics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the YearStatistics object and gathers books read this year.

methods.name: findReadBooksAddedThisYear
methods.description: Private method that filters books started reading in the current year with a rating.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the least liked book read this year, if any.

methods.name: findMostLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the most liked book read this year, if any.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGivenThisYear
methods.description: Calculates the average rating of books read this year.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Helper method to sum the ratings of books read this year.
